                <p class="article-excerpt">OpenAI's new o1 model family introduces advanced reasoning techniques, demonstrating significant improvements in complex problem-solving tasks such as mathematics, coding, and scientific research.                 <h3 class="article-title">Stability AI Launches Stable Diffusion 3.5 Turbo</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">The latest iteration of Stable Diffusion introduces faster inference times and improved image quality, particularly for photorealistic and stylized outputs. The model is available under a non-commercial license, with enterprise options for commercial use.</p>
                <a href="https://stability.ai/news/stable-diffusion-3-5-turbo" class="read-more">Read more →</a>
            </div>

                    <span>August 21, 2026</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">EU AI Act Enters Full Enforcement Phase</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">The European Union's comprehensive AI regulation is now fully enforceable, introducing risk-based classification for AI systems and stringent requirements for high-risk applications. Companies have a 12-month grace period to comply with the new rules.</p>
                <a href="https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai" class="read-more">Read more →</a>
            </div>

                    <span>August 23, 2026</span>
                </div>
                <h3 class="article-title">Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 2.0 with 1M Token Context Window</h3>
                <p class="article-excerpt">Gemini 2.0 expands its context window to 1 million tokens, enabling unprecedented long-form document analysis, video understanding, and multi-modal reasoning. The model is now available in Google Cloud and via API for enterprise users.</p>
                <a href="https://deepmind.google/technologies/gemini/" class="read-more">Read more →</a>
            </div>

                <p class="article-excerpt">The new Blackwell Ultra architecture delivers 2.5x performance improvement for training and inference tasks, with a focus on energy efficiency. Pre-orders are open for data center and workstation configurations.</p>
                <a href="https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-blackwell-ultra" class="read-more">Read more →</a>

                <p class="article-excerpt">PyTorch 2.5 introduces native support for 4-bit and 8-bit quantization, reducing model size and improving inference speed with minimal accuracy loss. The update also includes performance optimizations for AMD GPUs.</p>
